domain: Playwright browser automation, CLI, MCP, BrowserContext, pages, locators, network, authentication state, artifacts, CI, Docker, debugging, and agent-driven browser QA

method.candidateRequirements: Primary keywords contain 3 to 7 words, titles contain at most 45 characters, and every topic has codebase evidence plus official sources.
collisionChecks: Exact, containing, and contained slug comparison
Normalized title token overlap against inventory titles and H1 values
method.selectionRule: Keep only topics with a distinct task, failure mode, option, command, or contract that can support a 3000-word article without replacing an existing guide.

owners.playwright-cli: Terminal command workflows proved by the curated Playwright CLI skill and references.
owners.browser-runtime: BrowserContext, Page, Locator, request, response, and console behavior.
owners.playwright-runner: Playwright Test configuration and artifact path behavior.
owners.playwright-ci: CLI execution controls and CI failure policies.
owners.playwright-mcp: Playwright MCP operational testing and agent evidence contracts.
